devices.description: List of block devices to configure with their settings. Each entry must specify device.name and may specify any supported blktool command with a value matching its documented syntax (e.g., 'on'/'off', integer, or string). Only documented settings are allowed — no invented parameters. See blktool(8) for allowed values per command. Note: Commands that query (no argument) are omitted here since configuration is for *setting* values only. Commands that take no argument (e.g., 'reset', 'standby') are not configurable settings and thus excluded from this schema. Only commands that accept on/off or numeric/string arguments are included as optional fields per device.
